Agent Name: Verification_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to accurately verify the costs of the daily ticket and season pass for California's Great America in 2024. It incorrectly assumed the provided costs ($60 for a daily ticket and $120 for a season pass) were accurate based on vague historical ranges, whereas the actual 2024 prices were significantly higher (daily tickets around $100+ and season passes around $200+). This fundamental error in data retrieval/validation led to an incorrect calculation of savings ($120 instead of the correct $55).
